_comment: Observation-seed row source for campaign.py board (surface-seed track). playbook.json routes by TECH FINGERPRINT and behaviours.json by ENDPOINT SEMANTICS; on a generic host (plain Apache/SSH/SMB with no CVE fingerprint and no rich endpoint) BOTH produce 0 rows, so the board is empty and `next` has no action to return to. This third source seeds 1-3 high-value ENUMERATION rows off an OBSERVED SURFACE (service/port/tech), guaranteeing a never-empty board. board matches `match` (literal tokens, word-boundary) and optional `match_regex` (raw regex, e.g. a version string) against state.md's service/services/port/tech/os/notes columns. Each row names zero or more `roe` flags (no_bruteforce/no_dos/passive_only); if ANY named flag is set in scope.md the row is skipped (an active dir/vhost fuzz is a brute; a passive_only envelope forbids all active enum). Keep it LEAN: enumeration leads only, never exploit payloads. Add surfaces/rows here, no code.
